Last night's run: 700 tests, 698 passed, 2 failed. Both failures are in `auth/tokens.test.js`.

1. `refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token` — `auth/tokens.test.js:400`
2. `sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback` — `auth/tokens.test.js:650`

Both point at the same file, so token/session handling in auth is worth a look first.
